page.overview:
What is Floatzel?

Floatzel is a plump, orange, weasel/river otter-like Pokémon. It has a cream underbelly, two tails, a yellow floatation device looping around its body, two blue fins on its arms, orange fins on its head, and short legs.

Male Floatzel has two yellow spots on his back while female Floatzel has only one yellow spot on her back. This is the same case for its pre-evolution.

It has the ability Swift Swim. Swift Swim raises its speed in rain. It is known to be a very fast swimmer, and it saves the lives of drowning people by inflating its dinghy-like collar to create a surface to rescue them.

Floatzel evolves from Buizel starting at level 26.
